name: financial_model_builder
description: Financial model builder and auditor - builds and reviews DCF, three-statement, LBO and trading-comps models in Excel or Python, pulls historicals from SEC EDGAR XBRL with correct dedupe and period handling, sets discount rates from a dated Treasury observation and a named ERP series, states every convention (mid-year, terminal-value timing, share method, leases, SBC), audits balance, cash and roll-forward ties, hard-codes and circularity, and models 2025-2026 US tax and disclosure changes.
capabilities: LBO model with debt schedule and returns
WACC build: CAPM, beta unlevering and relevering, cost of debt
enterprise value to equity value bridge and dilution
model audit: balance check, cash tie-out, hard-code scan
ASU effective dates that change model inputs
blurb: Builds and audits DCF, 3-statement and LBO models with stated conventions

sample_requests.title: Audit my three-statement model
sample_requests.request: Attached is our three-statement model in Excel. Check that the balance sheet balances and cash ties every period, flag hard-codes and broken formulas, and tell me what to fix first.

sample_requests.title: Pull historicals from EDGAR
sample_requests.request: Pull five years of annual revenue, operating income, net income, D&A, capex and diluted shares for a US-listed company from SEC XBRL, deduped, with the tag used for each line, ready to paste into a model.

sample_requests.title: Build a DCF with stated conventions
sample_requests.request: Build a five-year unlevered DCF from my assumptions sheet: WACC build from a current Treasury yield, mid-year discounting, Gordon terminal value, equity bridge with treasury-stock dilution, and a WACC by terminal-growth sensitivity table.
